Chapter 527: Chapter 19: Influencing the Battlefields of Different Races (Please Subscribe)

For Lin Yuan, spending nearly half an hour to kill the ten most talented Tianyu Clan members at the Eighth Layer, each holding a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure, was the result of him holding back his full strength.

Even during that time, he was very careful, fearing that he might crush his opponents prematurely.

However, those watching Evolvers of Human Civilization at the unbeatable Eighth Layer were struck to the core with shock.

“The Galaxy Master has killed another unbeatable Eighth Layer being with a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure?”

“And this unbeatable Eighth Layer was one of the ten strongest Eighth Layer beings of the Tianyu Clan?”

Evolvers at the unbeatable Eighth Layer exclaimed in astonishment, even amongst the unbeatable of the Eighth Layer, there are levels of strength.

...

The unbeatable Evolvers that the Tianyu Clan sent out were, without a doubt, among the very best, and they even held Ninth-tier Secret Treasures?

And yet they were killed one by one by the Galaxy Master?

How incredible is this?

“Truly worthy of being the Galaxy Master!” The Baiyun Lord was exhilarated, as Lin Yuan, with his own power, ground the Tianyu Clan into the dust at the top tier of combat strength.

This greatly boosted the morale of their side.

Under these circumstances, the Baiyun Lord was confident they wouldn’t lose the war.

“Now is the time, launch the counterattack immediately.”

Just as the Baiyun Lord was about to command the many unbeatable Evolvers of the Eighth Layer,

he saw something unthinkable.

In the distance, the unbeatable Tianyu Clan members, as if frightened by something, began retreating towards the back.

“What?”

The Baiyun Lord was a bit dumbfounded.

He couldn’t understand why the Tianyu Clan would retreat en masse.

This meant that they had given up the battlefield completely, renouncing the war.

Why was this?

Although the Galaxy Master was very strong, he wasn’t extraordinarily so; he had even spent a good half-hour, and the Tianyu Clan could have sent more unbeatable Evolvers of the Eighth Layer to restrain him.

Why withdraw directly?

The Baiyun Lord could not comprehend it.

The unbeatable Evolvers of Human Civilization at the Eighth Layer also could not understand.

However,

at this moment,

Lin Yuan, standing in the sky above the battlefield, vanished without a trace.

In the depths of the heavy Spatial Layers, the countenance of that Ninth Rank Tianyu Clan powerhouse suddenly changed drastically.

“Not good.”

The Ninth Rank powerhouse wanted to act, but in the end, restrained himself.

Hum.

The next moment,

Lin Yuan appeared above the heads of the fleeing Tianyu Clan’s unbeatable Eighth Layer members.

“Die!”

With just a thought from Lin Yuan, the power that merged Space Rules with the many Cosmic Forces swept out.

This power was not fully formed, just halfway merged, but it could still be used with some effort.

Boom…

The invisible merged power swept across all directions, making the unbeatable Evolvers of the Tianyu Clan, as fragile as thin paper, disintegrate into powder.

“No…”

A few of the Tianyu Clan’s unbeatable Eighth Layer beings who had escaped some distance showed terror on their faces, followed by the sweeping power of the invisible force, disintegrating them as well.

In just a few breaths, the dozens of Tianyu Clan’s unbeatable Eighth Layer members, who had scattered and fled, all fell and died.

Although these unbeatable Eighth Layers still have their original bodies and haven’t died completely, forming an Avatar with strength close to the original is no easy feat.

It can be anticipated that for a long time to come, these unbeatable Tianyu Clan members at the Eighth Layer will not be able to support other battlefields.

“Space Bracelets…”

Lin Yuan lifted his right hand, and the numerous spatial storage Treasures of those Tianyu Clan unbeatable Eighth Layer members all fell into his hands.

Even though these unbeatable Eighth Layers wouldn’t carry excessively precious Treasures on them, they would at least carry Weapon Treasures of the Eighth Layer to ensure the strength of their Avatars.

The value of these Weapon Treasures, though not high individually, together constitute a considerable fortune, no less than two hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

“This, this…”

In the territory of the Tianyu Clan, the original bodies of the unbeatable Eighth Layer members opened their eyes, having just lost their Avatars, and now, their expressions were filled with shock.

“How could this be?”

“That Galaxy Master, his strength is too terrifying.”

“Ninth Rank, it must be Ninth Rank, Human Civilization has violated the rules, employing a Ninth Rank Evolver.”

“It shouldn’t be Ninth Rank; otherwise, our Ninth Rank would have acted long ago. However, the Galaxy Master, even if not Ninth Rank, must have exceeded the Ninth Rank threshold, or he wouldn’t be able to crush us like this…”

The hearts of the many unbeatable Eighth Layer members of the Tianyu Clan trembled.

A strong person at the beginning of Ninth Rank, who has yet to fathom the Complete Space Rules, would find it hard to kill an unbeatable Eighth Layer.

Yet, the Galaxy Master was able to sweep away a group of unbeatable Eighth Layers, and easily kill them, showing that his combat strength was incomparable to ordinary Ninth Rank strong individuals.

“That Galaxy Master has been hiding his true strength all along.”

“Now, I finally understand why our Ninth Rank ordered a retreat.”

“Human Civilization really is favored by the cosmos, having given birth to a freak like the Galaxy Master…”

The unbeatable Eighth Layer members of the Tianyu Clan spoke with complex tones, feeling fear, panic, awe, and a tinge of admiration towards Lin Yuan.

With the body of Eighth Layer, he unleashed the combat power of Ninth Rank. Although they didn’t know how the Galaxy Master achieved this, from an evolutionary perspective, he was undoubtedly ahead of them.

Not just ahead, but far surpassing all Eighth Layer beings of this generation.

Unprecedented in history, among the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, including those few Peak Clans, all Eighth Layer beings of this generation seem exceedingly trivial in front of the Galaxy Master.

…

On the side of Humanity,

all the Evolvers watched the unbeatable Tianyu Clan members at the Eighth Layer disintegrate under Lin Yuan’s feet.

They fell into an unconscious silence.

The spectacle before them was too stimulating; Lin Yuan had spent half an hour killing each of those Tianyu Clan prodigies who held a Ninth-tier Secret Treasure.
